evidence_policy.direct: Compiled original protocol message shape, parser branch, resource address entries or battle receiver geometry
evidence_policy.semantic: Field/name/command meanings from early generated descendant lineage unless explicitly direct
evidence_policy.not_established: Live commercial server payloads, display position, resource selector, storyboard, exact original UI interactions/quests/animations
